definition.title: Investigate vulnerability scanner finding
definition.description: Automatically runs the Analyst preset when a vulnerability finding has been reconciled to a Tracecat case.

case_id.description: Tracecat case UUID returned by the finding reconciliation step

scanner_assessment.description: Bounded scanner verdict requiring active validation

args.user_prompt: A vulnerability finding received by `${{ TRIGGER.source }}` was reconciled to Tracecat case `${{ TRIGGER.case_id }}` with assessment `${{ TRIGGER.scanner_assessment }}`. Investigate this case now. You are authorized to scan, verify impact, persist a justified proposal, and add material case comments without waiting for human confirmation. Stop before running either firewall task; the human reviews the case and decides whether to run one.
